# 100 Creatives

> 100 Creatives is an AI-powered creative agency in Calgary, Canada, that makes static and video ads, and the product imagery behind them, for DTC and consumer brands advertising on Meta, TikTok and Google. Abhi Chawla founded it in 2026. Every engagement is quoted in writing, and ad creative budgets start at $4,000 USD.

## Key facts

- Company: 100 Creatives, a brand of 2587689 Alberta Ltd.
- Founded: 2026. Founder: Abhi Chawla.
- Address: #315, 405 64 Ave NE, Calgary, Alberta, Canada T2J 6J6
- What we make: static ads, AI-made video ads, UGC-style statics, product and lifestyle imagery, campaign imagery, and brand-trained production workflows for in-house teams
- Who it's for: DTC and consumer brands advertising on Meta, TikTok and Google
- Pricing (USD): ad creative is quoted in budget ranges of $4,000 to $10,000, $10,000 to $25,000, $25,000 to $50,000 and $50,000+. Product photography from $5,000 per project. Apparel 100-SKU programmes from $10,000. Workflows and engines from $4,000 per build. There is no unlimited plan.
- Turnaround: creative batches in 48 hours; revisions within 48 hours
- Client work: mostly under NDA. The public portfolio is spec work (concepts made for brands such as Chobani, Ralph Lauren and Porsche that did not commission them), and every spec piece is labeled.
- Contact: abhi@paperkites.co, or book a call at https://tidycal.com/abhixchawla/strategy-web
- Not affiliated with: the "100 Creatives" static ad template pack sold by Chase Chappell, the 100creatives podcast from 100cameras, Hundred Creatives, or Adweek's Creative 100 list
